answer: We define the Sybil-resistant framework using a trellis of interconnected staking collateral nodes where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds impose a non-linear capital barrier. By calibrating the subgame-perfect slashing matrix, the expected utility of participant multiplication becomes strictly negative as every adversarial inlet for protocol manipulation is met with zero-knowledge verifiable delay penalties. A robust Nash equilibrium converges when the marginal expenditure of creating a digital dune of fictitious entities exceeds any extractable value.
